picks.excerpt: Amazon's firmware 5.19.5 for Kindle and Kindle Scribe rolls out 'Story So Far' — spoiler-free recaps up to your current reading position for thousands of English-language books — plus improved Scribe annotation tools and cross-device bookmarking. Story So Far extends Amazon's AI-generated Recaps feature (introduced 2025) from series level to in-book progress. By Michael Kozlowski.

Hong Zhou and Adam Hyde argue that autonomous AI agents are splitting scholarly publishing platforms into a 'trusted core' database layer and a separate 'agentic layer' where agents — not humans staring at yesterday's interface — do the interacting. The shift undermines per-seat SaaS pricing and forces vendors to rethink where platform value accumulates.
